name: OpenRouter
description: Chat with any OpenRouter text model and generate images, video and speech or transcribe audio through OpenRouter, with your own OpenRouter API key. Outputs are saved to the library.

models.title: Model tools
models.description: Comma-separated OpenRouter video, image or speech models (vendor/name) that get their own typed tool. Leave empty for none.

chat_model.title: Default chat model
chat_model.description: Model openrouter_chat uses when a call names none.

cache_ttl_hours.title: Catalog cache (hours)
cache_ttl_hours.description: How long model catalogs and search results are cached on disk.

max_wait_minutes.title: Max wait (minutes)
max_wait_minutes.description: How long to wait for a video job before the call stops waiting. OpenRouter cannot cancel jobs, so the job keeps running and is billed; the error quotes its id for openrouter_video_result.

max_chat_tokens.title: Chat max_tokens ceiling
max_chat_tokens.description: openrouter_chat refuses calls whose max_tokens is above this.

allow_url_inputs.title: Allow URL file inputs
allow_url_inputs.description: Let model file inputs be https URLs. OpenRouter and the model provider fetch them, so anything in the link is shared with them. Off: library artifacts only.
